covered: Fully lowered fixed tracing image with no imported SDK summaries/records, unique nominal class/table/function identities and closed registry
Direct constant-CID object creation with exact field count and available table

open_boundaries: Imported SDK allocation completeness is not yet exported; imports retain original wide behavior
Native and indirect closure/reflection calls, unknown runtime factories and dynamic allocation CIDs retain wide behavior

Class proof is image-local. Clearing metadata cannot revive already pruned functions. New module joins, registration mutation or new unknown allocation require rebuilding from fresh fully lowered input. No post-prune merge behavior has been certified.
ordinary_file_explorer: Remains conservative due imported SDK and active FFI. This is an explicit first coverage boundary, not a permanent all-FFI policy or a claim that every C call creates Dart objects.

arbitrary_or_registered_class_ids.why: Uses caller supplied class_id and field_count.
Caller supplied CID plus supplied method table registration.
Allocates class ID selected from registered FfiCompound layout keyed by RTI; seed exact registered compound classes or remain unknown.

exposure_routes.why: May expose runtime allocation or registry symbol addresses. The resolved name/target must be certified, not inferred neutral from pointer return ABI.
Reserved runtime catalog resolver can provide address of allocation or registration API.
Returned Handle is validated against a live current-isolate cell. This is reference provenance, not a blanket arbitrary-class allocator; callbacks/runtime API access still require coverage.

native_audit.neutral_call_obligation: Numeric/pointer-only native ABI does not by itself prove absence of callbacks, dynamic runtime symbol lookup or registry/class allocation side effects inside foreign code. Prefer exact runtime-source/transitive callee summaries and certified callback targets; keep genuinely unknown foreign targets conservative.

next_required_summary: Export per-definition allocation class sets and an explicit unknown-allocation bit in SDK pruning summaries. Include allocations inside functions, not only the class of returned values.

Bind runtime primitive allocation kinds and configured runtime CIDs to the exact compiler/runtime/SDK artifacts. Exception/stacktrace/closure/list/record and FFI compound classes must be covered even when construction has no source NewInstance.
Reconcile imported allocation facts with class/table identity, registered ancestry and live callable/callback targets. Only live unknown allocation/exposure widens the candidate universe.

Add non-allocating/native-existing-reference contracts proved from exact bodies/transitive calls; distinguish ordinary numeric/pointer FFI from Handle/callback/registry/dynamic symbol exposure without backend or platform name filtering.
